description: Test suite for OAuth application management API endpoints in Mattermost, including creation, update, retrieval, deletion, secret regeneration, and OAuth client registration, with audit logging and feature flag checks.

methods.name: TestCreateOAuthApp
methods.description: Tests creation of OAuth apps, permission checks, validation, and error handling.

methods.name: TestUpdateOAuthApp
methods.description: Tests updating OAuth apps, permission checks, and validation.

methods.name: TestGetOAuthApps
methods.description: Tests retrieval of OAuth apps list with pagination and permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetOAuthApp
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific OAuth app by ID with permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetOAuthAppInfo
methods.description: Tests retrieval of OAuth app info with client secret sanitization and permission checks.

methods.name: TestDeleteOAuthApp
methods.description: Tests deletion of OAuth apps with permission checks and error handling.

methods.name: TestRegenerateOAuthAppSecret
methods.description: Tests regeneration of OAuth app secrets with permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetAuthorizedOAuthAppsForUser
methods.description: Tests listing OAuth apps authorized for a user.

methods.name: TestNilAuthorizeOAuthApp
methods.description: Tests error handling when authorizing OAuth app with nil request.

methods.name: TestRegisterOAuthClient
methods.description: Tests dynamic client registration (DCR) for OAuth clients, including validation, success, and audit logging.

methods.name: TestRegisterOAuthClient_DisabledFeatures
methods.description: Tests DCR feature flag restrictions and error responses.

methods.name: TestRegisterOAuthClient_RedirectURIAllowlist
methods.description: Tests redirect URI allowlist validation during DCR.

methods.name: TestRegisterOAuthClient_PublicClient_Success
methods.description: Tests successful registration of public OAuth clients via DCR.

methods.name: TestRegisterOAuthClientAudit
methods.description: Verifies audit logging for successful and failed DCR requests.
